line: push    esi; Verified inverse lock-state helper: if this reference has an ExtraLock wrapper, clears its locked bit; otherwise follows the linked-door reference and clears that wrapper's locked bit. It then marks the owning reference or linked door modified with mask 0x40.

call    TeleportData_GetLinkedDoor; Verified TeleportData_GetLinkedDoor returns TeleportData.linkedDoor from offset +0. This operates on TeleportData, which is the payload pointer stored at ExtraTeleport+0x0C, not on the ExtraTeleport object itself.

call    TeleportData_GetLinkedDoor; Verified TeleportData_GetLinkedDoor returns TeleportData.linkedDoor from offset +0. This operates on TeleportData, which is the payload pointer stored at ExtraTeleport+0x0C, not on the ExtraTeleport object itself.

call    TESObjectREFR_FindLockExtraOnLinkedDoorChain; Verified wrapper lookup: follows linked-door references until it finds an ExtraLock wrapper, returning that wrapper or null when the chain ends without lock data.

call    ExtraLock_ClearLockedFlag; Verified: clears only ExtraLockData.flags bit 0x01 (Locked), preserving bit 0x02. OpenEffect uses this after its lock-category test; this preserves LockEffect's bit-0x02 ownership marker.

jmp     TESObjectREFR_MarkLockDataAsModified; Verified modified-state propagation: if this reference has lock data, calls TESFormVtbl::MarkAsModified with mask 0x40; otherwise, if its linked-door chain has lock data, marks that linked-door reference with the same mask.
